integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically by an exact Fourier-to-incidence reduction, graph-rank computation, cyclotomic minimal-polynomial argument, and reduced-incidence determinant expansion. Finite computation is used only for replay checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies basis partners for the specific two-line-plus-one-point family in \(\mathbb F_p^2\); it does not determine the minimizing Riesz ratio.
The determinant formula controls a product of singular values and does not by itself resolve the asymptotic behavior of \(\rho(E_p)\).
An unindexed or differently phrased equivalent graph reformulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: A unicyclic graph criterion for basis partners of the two-line Riesz family
